candidate: Original Canvas cross; no Apple symbol artwork or font data copied
contentAdapter: Default content data preserve caller objects; layout-transparent hosts explicitly use flattenChildren and participates; padding applies to each flattened child
presentationAdapter: BleeckerModal is a content view with contextual window dismissal; BleeckerModalDialog owns a Qt Popup.Window and recreates its caller Component on reopen
widthAdapter: modalWidth fixes the visible body; width is the independent caller allocation and may be zero while the body remains 480
inputAdapter: Rounded visual clipping preserves input outside the body; Close uses the measured pixel-aligned symbol hit region at font sizes 13 and 20, DPR one/two
defaultInheritedFont: Encode Sans 13 candidate; native inherited SF fonts remain unapproved
fixedTitleFont: Encode Sans semibold 18, independent of parent font and text scale
lifecycleScope: Qt QObject destruction is recorded independently from native onDisappear callbacks
